tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// phur pa'i las byang bzhugs// ༄༅// hūm̐ a la la ho/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ 'phags mchog thugs rje can gyi dus la bab// khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab// mthu chen mthu stobs bcom ldan 'das// byin chen byin rlobs bcom ldan 'das// dbang chen dbang bskur bcom ldan 'das// dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod// mtshon chen sngon po 'bar ba'i ngang*// nam mkha'i dkyil nas thigs pa shar// srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang*// snying gi sgo ru bsgom par bya// snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni// bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te// phung po rdo rjes gtams byas nas// rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dīb+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams// srid pa rdo rje grub mdzod cig /srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha// ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// nga nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa// sku yi dbyings su bdag gyur cig /thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du// byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba// sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa// dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro dhe shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ oṃ bud+dha shrī he ru ka bud+dha kro dhe shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na kro dhe shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka pad+ma kro dhe shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ oṃ karma shrī he ru kro dhe shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhe hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra kro dhe ti sha bya hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra u ya ka mu kha he/ badz+ra u shi ka mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha las+ya ke hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra byā ghṛ mu kha he/ badz+ra tra ta mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ni daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha tra te hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra tsa ma ra mu kha he/ badz+ra tra na mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhash+ma na pa ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra ha ri ka mu kha he badz+ra u lū ka mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐ ban+dha ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhe mu la ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra byā ghṛ mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa hūm̐/ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra kro dha dzā ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra dz+wa la mu kha he/ badz+ra pak+ṣi ta mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐ ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sha ya ti hūm̐ phaṭa badz+ra badz+re tsa ta mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐/ tshin+bh+ya tshin+bh+ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha bā ya be hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra siṃ ha mu kha he/ badz+ra ti ti la mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai la kya bi dza ya hūm̐/ bhin+bh+ya bhin+bh+ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra ta sha mu kha he/ badz+ra na ku la mu kha he/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha tsun+da mu ne hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra rig shi ka mu kha he/ badz+ra si ka mu kha he/ de nas ha brgyad he brgyad phaṭa bh+yo nyi shu rtsa brgyad brjod do// //skye med rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las// skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yam yum ma lus kun// sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sras po badz+ra kī la ya// zhe sdang bdud 'dul khro bo'i rgyal po dbyings nas bzhengs// rdo rje srin po phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir// mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs// badz+ra kī la ya dzaḥ

shar phyogs smug nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// bud+dha 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya// gti mug bdud 'dul khro bo'i rgyal po dbyings nas bzhengs// rdo rje srin po phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir// mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs// bud+dha kī la ya dzaḥ lho phyogs ser nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// rin chen 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya// nga rgyal bdud 'dul khro bo'i rgyal po dbyings nas bzhengs// rdo rje srin po phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir// mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs// rat+na kī la ya dzaḥ nub phyogs dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// pad+ma 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya// 'dod chags bdud 'dul khro bo'i rgyal po dbyings nas bzhengs// rdo rje srin po phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir// mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs// pad+ma kī la ya dzaḥ byang phyogs ljang nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// karma 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya// phrag dog bdud 'dul khro bo'i rgyal po dbyings nas bzhengs// rdo rje srin po phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir// mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs// karma kī la ya dzaḥ dīb ta tsakra phur bu'i lha// dmar po gcer bu ral pa can// sku stod khro bo chen po la// zhal gsum phyag kyang drug pa ste// ral gri'i skra la phur bu'i so// lte ba man chad sku yi cha rnams ni// ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab ma 'dra// 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i 'od// lcags kyi phur pa zur gsum pa// drag po gyur pa'i phur bu ste// btab na lha yang brlag 'gyur te// gnod byed bgegs la smos ci dgos// oṃ badz+ra kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ mdzad la sogs ye shes khro bo bcu// gdug pa'i 'khor tshogs ma lus kun 'dul ba// rdo rje srin po phur pa bsgrub pa'i phyir// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs// ta kṛ ta khro rgyal gdug pa 'dul la sogs// hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyis phyogs skyong zhabs kyis mnan// 'jigs byed chen po khro rgyal yab yum bcas// srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol// srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa dang*// dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir// dmigs med mkha' dbyings dag pa nas// ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol// oṃ a h+ye hi bha ga wān/

ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a we sha ya a/ ye shes khro rgyal gshegs nas kyang*// rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*// kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol// khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya// thugs rje ngang nyid zhi ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// skye med dbyings nas sprul pa'i sku byung ba// 'jigs byed rngam stobs khro bo'i tshul du ston// khro rgyal sku la gnyis med lhun sbyor ba// 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma la phyag 'tshal lo// ma g.yos chos mchog sku gsung thugs kyi bdag /sdug bsngal log par 'khyam pa'i sems can rnams// thugs rje dbyer med dbyings su sdud mdzad pa// sprul pa'i khro bo'i rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khro mo dbang phyug sku la nyer gnas pa// thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// mkha' 'gro mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba// gdug pa 'dul mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med cing*// 'dod dgur sgyur ba'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che// ma sring byams pa'i tshul du grogs mdzad ma// phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pu ho pra ti pu ho/ bde bar gshegs pa khyed ci 'dra// de 'dra kho nar bdag gyur cig /spyod pa rmad byung bsam yas pa// 'gro la phan phyir bdag gis kyang*// byang chub sems mchog dam pa dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya 'di// srog gi phyir yang mi gtang na// rdo rje rgyal pos byin gyis rlobs// dus ngan tha ma'i 'jig rten 'dir// sangs rgyas mdzad dka' bdag gis bgyi// byang chub spyad dka' bdag gis spyad// rdo rje rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag cag bsam pa 'grub gyur cig /dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dpal bo sgeg pa 'jigs su rung ba dang*// dgod dang gshe dang 'jigs su rung ba dang*// snying rje rngam dang zhi ba la sogs pa// sku yi dngos po shin tu bzang po yis// bdud bzhi rtag tu 'joms pas dpa' dpa' 'dra// rgyan dang cha lugs ldan pas sgeg sgeg 'dra// sku che yan lag rags pas 'jigs 'jigs 'dra// zhal g.yas dkar la bzhad pas dgod dgod 'dra// zhal g.yon dmar la gdangs pas gshe gshe 'dra// zhal dbus mthing la rngam pas khro khro 'dra// rgyud drug thugs rjes 'dzin pas snyi rje che che 'dra// gdug pa zhal du 'dren pas rngam rngam 'dra// de 'dra khro bo 'jigs pa'i skur bstan yang*// chos sku mtshan ma med pas zhi zhi 'dra// rdo rje rtse dgus sa dgu'i rtog pa 'joms// rdo rje rtse lngas rgyud lnga rab tu sgrol// ye shes me dpung 'bar bas nyon mongs sreg par byed// kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod// ri rab phur bus khams gsum dbang du sdud// de 'dra'i khro bo 'jigs skur gshegs nas kyang*// badz+ra kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol// zhes bstod do// oṃ shrī badz+ra mud+ga ra sha ya na maḥ

oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga sa ma ya na maḥ oṃ shrī badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga pra dz+wa la ya na maḥ oṃ shrī badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe tsa la ya na maḥ hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo /rnam rgyal snyems ma stag dang bya rgod mgo /dbyug sngon sder mo g.yag dang bya rog mgo /gshin rje dur khrod sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo /mi g.yo gtun khung gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo /rta mgrin gtum mo'i byi la pu shud mgo /gzhan gyis mi thub mda' snyem spyang ki khra yi mgo /bdud rtsi rlung 'byin seng ge pha wang mgo /khams gsum gsod ma dred dang sre mo'i mgo /stobs chen bskyod ma dom dang byi ba'i mgo /de 'dra'i khro bo 'jigs skur gshegs nas kyang*// rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*// kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod de// gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya ni// kau rī ban byis dbyugs pa sngo// tsau rī mda' gzhu 'gengs pa ser// pra mo chu srin rgyal mtshan dmar// be tā byis za rdor 'phyang gnag /puk+ka dmar ser byis rgyu 'dren// kasma dung dmar khrag 'thung ljang*// sma sha mthing nag byis snying za// tsan+dha mchog skye ser lus 'brel// 'bar ba'i gdan la gshegs nas kyang*// mchod bzhes dam skongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// siṃ ha dkar po snol seng seng*// byā ghṛ gnas lta snol ma stag /sri la nag mo zhing ldag wa// sho na 'dra ltas mthing ga khyi// kṛ ta mgrin dmar rgyu mgo rgod// kang ka kang phrag snar mgo ring*// kha khwa khan rog ban gri nag /hu lu dho rgyu mthing tshogs 'ug /pu shud gdong can sngon mo lcags kyu 'dzin// bya rog gdong can ser mo mche zhags can// nyi zla lcags sgrog me 'bar ma// thal byed dril bu sna tshogs mdog /'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs nas kyang*// mchod bzhes dam skongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// bde bar gshegs pa khro rgyal gtso// rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes kyis// srid pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun// kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol// na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/

bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hās me tog gtor/ yang dang yang du dag mod kyi// 'gro ba kun gyi don slad du// phyag dang zhabs ni bsil nas kyang*// rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// oṃ pa ni pan pe nu su ra to ti su pa ra mu ta thā ga ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ sa ma yo ta mu/ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā su kha ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ shrī badz+ra dhūp+pe du/ shrī badz+ra puṣ+pe pu/ shrī badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ shrī badz+ra gan+dhe aḥ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi// rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman// rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos// ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas// rgyud lnga'i sems can kun sgrol phyir// dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di// ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po// thugs dam dbyings nyid bskul ba'i phyir// 'di ni sngon gyi dam tshig go /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la// sku gsung thugs kyi ngang nyid du// bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes te kun tu dgyes mdzod la// 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// na maḥs rba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho/ shrī ban+dha khā hi/ pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang*// yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje che dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// na maḥsarba 'gre/ ye shes bskal ba me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// 'jigs byed chen po khro bo bcu rnams la// rnam dag bdud rtsi zhes sogs kun la 'gre'o// khro rgyal sku la gnyis med lhun sbyor ba// sgra 'byin la sogs khro mo bcu rnams la// rig pa'i rgyal po'i khro bo'i thugs las sprul// de 'khor la sogs phra men brgyad rnams la// mthing ga mchod snyems rdo rje gsang ba'i yum// gau rī la sogs khro mo brgyad rnams la// sna tshogs mgo brnyan za byed mche gshog la// sidha la sogs phra men brgyad rnams la// sti ra 'ching sdom 'ching byed dbang mo che// pu shud la sogs sgo ma bzhi rnams la// dpal gyi 'khor tshogs za byed dbang mo che// mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro ma sring rgya mtsho la// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/

khams gsum gdug pa ma lus kun sgrol ba'i// skyes bu ging chen bco brgyad la// 'byung po thams cad 'dul bar dam bcas pa'i// dpag bsam shing gi lha mo'i tshogs rnams la// 'dod pa'i khams kyi bud med nyag gcig ma// dpal ldan gnyan gyi rdo rje re ma tī// gdug pa 'dul ba'i pho nyar khas blangs pa'i// dpal chen thugs las skyes pa'i shwa na mu kha la// nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med cing*// 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i bdag nyid chen mo la// yang byin dang ni de byin dang*// bse byin dang ni phag byin dang*// dam can bse yi lha mo'i tshogs rnams la// sdom la gnas shing rigs 'dzin grub pa'i lha// lha dang lha min phyogs bcu'i rnal 'byor la// nya bzhi dus drug dben gnas srung ma la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtse dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// nyes legs stang 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod la// dam tshig dbang dang shes rgyud gab sbas pa'i// nges pa'i lung ston rdo rje slob dpon la// sngar gshegs khyad par rim par dbang bskur ba// rgyal theb spyan dang dkar mo gang rnams la// 'di dang phyi ma gnyis kar mi 'bral ba'i// dam tshig gzungs kyis 'brel ba'i mched lcam la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje che dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho/ shrī ban+dha khā hi/ pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam par sbyar ba 'di// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te// thugs dam bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ shrī he ru ka i daṃ/ dhū paṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dī ga gan+dhaṃ/ ba liṃ pra tīts+tsha ho/ hrī ban+dha khā hi/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ thog mar bdag nyid rtog sgom bsgral// des na gnyis med blo yis ni// blo ngan 'jig rten snying re rje// gnyis su med par bsgral bar bya// 'khril ba'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor ba// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// pad+ma la ni rdo rje bzhugs// bdag nyid mchod pas mnyes bya'o// sa ma ya hoḥ

sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rā ga ya/ a nu rā ga yā mi/ bo dhi tsit+ta/ mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas chen po dag /bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la dbul// bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni// dkyil 'khor la yang dkyil 'khor thim// a la la ste dkyil 'khor la yang dkyil 'khor thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra a be sha ya a be sha ya pra we sha ya pra tīts+tsha ho shrī ban+dha khā hi/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang*// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// dpal chen 'khor bcas spyan drangs te// dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru// zhing chen gsar rnying sti rar bcas// dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ rgya mtshor bskyil// mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs bcas kyis// ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sa ma ya rak+ta mu dra sa ma ya kha kha khā hi hṛ da pi pa tha hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ nga ni za byed chen po ste// khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba dang*// gdul dka' mtha' dag gdul ba'i phyir// sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya// nga ni khrag 'thung chen po ste// dmar chen pos ni rgya mtshor bskyil// 'khor ba'i drwa ba gcad pa'i phyir// 'khor gyi phra men tshogs rnams kyis// ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā mam̐ sa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ mahā a mṛ ta khā hi/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs// gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// shin tu mi bzad dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku// zhe sdang thugs mchog yak+ṣa he ru ka /ye shes sku mchog rigs kyi 'khor gyis bskor// mi dmigs thugs kyi don dam thugs la gsal// gsung gi nga ros khams gsum dbang du sdud// sprul pa'i byin rlabs khro bcu dbyings na dgyes// sku stod mthing nag 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan// g.yas kyi zhal mdog ljang nag bstan pa ni// phrin las thams cad lhun gyis grub pa'i rtags// g.yon gyi zhal mdog dmar nag bstan pa ni// dbang drag rnam gnyis dus gcig rdzogs pa'i rtags// skye 'gro rtsad nas gcod pa'i mche gtsigs shing*// nyon mongs log par lta ba 'joms pa'i rtags// rdo rje rtse dgu phyag na bsnams pa ni// sa dgu'i rtog 'joms ye shes dgu dang sbyor// rdo rje rtse lnga phyag na bsnams pa ni// rgyud lnga sbyong zhing sku lnga 'dren par mdzad// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba bsnams pa ni// khams gsum 'khor ba'i bag chags sreg par mdzad// rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ brdung zhing 'khrol ba ni// bdud bzhi thal bar rlog cing dbang du sdud// ri rab phur bu 'dril zhing 'debs pa ni// 'gal byed ma lus thams cad sgrol bar mdzad// glang chen stag lpags zhing chen rgyan gyis brgyan// che btsan dpe med khams gsum rgyal bar ston// thod sbrul sna tshogs 'jigs pas sku la brgyan// bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs// rngam pa'i zhal nas hūm̐ sgra 'brug stong sgrogs// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul gyis dbyings su sbyor// zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor stabs gdug pa 'dul// sprul pa'i byin rlabs phyogs bcu sprin ltar gtibs// thugs rje rtse gcig breng breng rgyun du dgongs// oṃ badz+ra ki' li kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ bam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

da yum e ka dza ṭī bskul te// de dang gnyis med sbyor ba'i yum mchog ni// e ka dza ṭī gu h+ya gsang ba'i yum// pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug mkha' klong nas// bai ḍūr sngon po'i sku mdog gsal 'tsher zhing*// in+d+ra nī la ral pa gcig tu 'khyil// kham kham tshig tshig ral pa me ltar 'bar// puṣ+pa rā ga'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros// khro gnyer spyan zlum 'jigs pa'i sdang mig ma// kas ma kas ma rno dpal mche ba gtsigs// thams cad chem chem gsol ba'i rkan thog thog /thod khrag rlon chen phreng ba'i sbrul zhags kyis// mthing ga'i sku la rab tu mdzes par brgyan// zhing chen g.yang gzhis gsang ba sku smad g.yogs// khrag mtsho tha mar skems shing ljags 'dril ma// thod rlon klad khrag bsres pa g.yas na thogs// bhan+dha rtse gsum 'bar ba g.yon na thogs// 'khor lo'i rgyas 'debs za byed dpal gyi yum// rdo rje me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// zhing chen bam ro bsnol ba'i gdan stengs na// gzir cing gnon pa brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// thams cad dbang du sdud pa'i sring gcig ma// bar snang 'phyo ba'i me za brag gyon ma// gling bzhi kun la dbang ba'i drag mo rgyal// srog gi snying po'i don las ma 'da' cig /dam rdzas dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ 'di sbrengs pas// thugs dam rtse gcig bring bring rgyun du dgongs// rang rgyud dag pa'i rnal 'byor sgrub pa po// brda dang sbyugs pa rngam pa'i thal mo'i sgras// rak+ta chags pa'i sgra yis g.yab 'dor na// glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs shig /thal mo rdebs shing 'jigs pa'i bshud glu len// bsdigs pa'i gad mo dgod cing khrag chen 'thung*// dus gsum kun la ma bsgribs mkhyen mnga' ba// dmar gyi dri snom khrag gi ro myang ba// dpag tshad brgyad khri'i gnas nas 'dir gshegs la// sha za khrag 'thung glang po las kyi rnams// ye shes rmad byung don dam dgongs pa can// gzhan gyis ma bskul nyid kyis zhal 'ches ma// dam tshig bskul phyir rtag tu rol mdzod cig

/phrin las gzhung bzhin pho nya mang po 'gyed// dam tshig gzhung bzhin thams cad dbang du sdud// phrin las dus la bab bo sring gcig ma// mngon sum bsgrub pa'i las mdzod da tshur byon// oṃ dīb ta tsakra hūm̐/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ trag rak+ṣa kha mun+ta ru lu ru snying kha rag badz+ra dun dun bh+yo/ hūm̐ ka ri ka pa ta ri/ na bal tshul mo te/ kha dam/ di ta ta ta ma shaṃ/ raṃ raṃ kha kha la bag bh+yo/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab// phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la bab// steng gi phyogs nas dgra dang bgegs 'gugs pa// khro bo chen po badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra// dbu gsum phyag drug gshog pa can// rdo rje phur bu'i 'dril zhing 'debs// zhabs drug brag stengs nyi zla pho mo gnon// rdo rje sgra 'byin khro mo yang*// 'jigs byed chen mor snang ba ste// dgyes pa'i longs spyod don dam dbyings chen las// sprul ba'i pho nya mang po phyogs bcur 'gyed// dgra bgegs snying nas drongs shig khug /'di phyogs bzhir 'gre'o// shar gyi phyogs nas khro chen rnam par rgyal// dri zar gnon= /rdo rje snyems ma khro mo yang*// shar lho'i mtshams nas khro chen dbyug sngon can// me lha gnon= /rdo rje sder mo khro mo yang*// lho phyogs khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed// gshin rje= /rdo rje dur khrod khro mo yang*// lho nub khro bo chen po mi g.yo mgon// srin po= /rdo rje gtun khung khro mo yang*// nub phyogs= khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin rgyal// chu lha= /rdo rje gtum mo khro mo yang*// nub byang khro bo chen po gzhan gyis mi thub pa// rlung lha= /rdo rje mda' snyems khro mo yang*// byang gi khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil// gnod sbyin= /rdo rje rlung 'byin khro mo yang*// byang shar khro bo chen po khams gsum rnam par rgyal// dbang ldan=

/rdo rje khro mo gsod ma yang*// 'og gi phyogs nas dgra dang bgegs 'gugs pa// khro bo chen po stobs po che// dbu gsum phyag drug gshog pa can// rdo rje phur bu 'dril zhing 'debs// zhabs drug brag steng sa bdag gnon// rdo rje bskyod ma khro mo yang*// 'jigs byed chen mor snang ba ste// dgyes pa'i longs spyod don dam dbyings chen las// sprul pa'i pho nya mang po phyogs bcur 'gyed// dgra bgegs snying nas khug cig drangs/ bh+yo phyag brnyan chen mo'i dus la bab// dpal gyi pho nya 'gugs byed pa// steng gi phyogs nas byung ba yi// rnam rtog mi mnga' phag pho la// mi pho phag gi mgo can zhon// lag pa g.yas pa tho ba thogs// g.yon pa phur bu 'dril zhing 'debs// dgra bgegs snying nas drongs shig khug /yan lag chings la skyugs su chug /des 'gre'o// shar gyi phyogs= /dpa' gtum za byed chen mo la// g.yas pa rdo rje thogs= /g.yon phur bus 'gre'o// shar lho= /mi 'gyur g.yag po chen po la// g.yas pa dbyug tho thogs// lho= /'jug byed chen po sha ba la// g.yas pa dgra sta= /lho nub= /spyod rdzogs gzig po chen po la// g.yas pa ral gri= /nub= /mkhas brtson byi la chen po la// g.yas na sbrul zhags= /nub byang= /za byed chen po spyang gi la// g.yas na ba dan= /byang= /'joms byed rtsal 'phags seng ge la// g.yas pa rdo rje rgya gram= /byang shar phyogs nas dgra dang bgegs 'dul ba'i// stobs ldan dred po chen po la// g.yas pa rdo rje= /smyo byed dom po chen po la// g.yas pa tri shū la= /steng gi phyogs nas dgra dang bgegs 'gugs pa'i// smyo byed rmigs bu chen po la// g.yas pa rmigs bu= /shar= /mkha'i lding thogs med bya rgod la// g.yas pa lcags kyu= /shar lho= /rigs shes bya rog chen mo la// g.yas pa me dbal= /lho= /mun mthong 'ug pa chen mo la// g.yas pa zhags pa=

/lho nub sbed byed khwa da chen mo la// g.yas pa lcags kyu= /nub= /'od ldan gsal bkra pu shud la// g.yas pa rnga yab= /nub byang gsod byed khro mo chen mo la// g.yas pa khra bya= /byang= /sgrin mo dar ldan pha wang la// g.yas pa sgron me= /byang shar= /gsod byed zer mo chen mo la// g.yas pa lcags kyu= /dpal gyi pho nya mgyogs byed ma// 'og gi phyogs nas 'byung ba ni// don dbyings sbyor ba'i byi ba la// mi mo byi ba'i mgo can zhon// lag pa g.yas na sog le thogs// g.yon pa phur bu 'dril zhing 'debs// dgra bgegs snying nas drongs shig khug /yan lag chings la skyugs su chug /khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab// dkyil 'khor de yi phyi rim na// gau rī la sogs khro mo brgyad// phog par rgyob cig gau rī ma// snying la gzer cig tsau ri mā// dbang du sdus shig pra mo ha// rdul du rlog cig be tā lī// rgyu zhags drongs shig puk+ka sī// rak+ta 'thungs shig ghasma rī// tsit+ta drongs shig sma sha nī// mgo lus phrol cig tsaṇ+ḍa lī// dkyil 'khor de'i phyi rim na// mu kha chen mo phra men brgyad// sha la rol cig sidha ma// rus pa 'cho zhig byā ghṛ ma// khrag la rol cig sri la ma// lpags chen hrol cig shwa na ma// rgyu zhags drongs shig kṛ ta ma// snying khrag 'thungs shig kam̐ ka ma// rgyu tshil brobs shig kha khwa ma// glo snying phyung shig u lū ma// dkyil 'khor de yi phyi rim na// mthar byed chen mo sgo ma bzhi// snying nas drongs shig lcags kyu ma// yan lag chings shig zhags pa ma// dbang po sdoms shig lcags sgrog ma// rdul du rlog cig dril bu ma// dkyil 'khor de yi phyi rim na// dbang phyug la sogs nyi shu brgyad// shar nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun// khyed kyis zhi ba'i las mdzod cig /lho nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun// khyed kyis rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig

/nub nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun// khyed kyis dbang gi las mdzod cig /byang nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun// khyed kyis drag po'i las mdzod cig /'bar ma'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas ma lus kun// sngon gyi dam tshig chen pos rjes dgongs te// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus gdul ba dang*// kī la ya yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// khyed rang thugs dam dus la babs// ye nas mnyam nyid chos sku dag pa la// ma rig dbang gis sgro dang skur btab ste// bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs ngo bor smin// de bzlog don phyir rgyal ba'i dam mnos pa// bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis// bag med tshul gyis dam las 'das gyur te// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang ci 'gal ba// thugs rje che mnga' khyod la bzod par gsol// bzod par gsol lo tshangs par stsal du gsol// lus kyis sdig byas sdig pa ngan du bgyis// ngag gis tshig 'khyal smras pa ngag tu brjod// sems kyis blo nor log par bsams la sogs// 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs bgyis pa// bkra ba'i lha tshogs khyed la bzod par gsol// bzod par gsol lo tshangs par stsal du gsol// ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang*// de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin rnams// mi yi skyon mthong tsam na rlag par mdzad// chags nyams 'gal 'khrul ci mchis mthol lo bshags// mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yi// sku mdog mthing nag 'jig tshul bstan pa ni// yab yum thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med// 'khor gyi phra men pho nya'i tshogs la sogs// yun ring dus nas bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i lha// drag por 'byung khyed dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtso bo la stong rtsa brgyad/ 'khor la brgya rtsa brgyad/ gau rī dang tsau rī dang sgo ma la nyi shu rtsa re re/

dbang phyug ma la bdun bdun dbul lo// 'dzab bstod do// dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa khyab pa'i sku// spyan drangs gshegs su gsol bar mi dmigs pas// thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos sku dag pa la// ye shes sgyu mar rol te gshegs su gsol// ye shes phung po mkha' 'dra ba// sprul sku kun gyi 'byung gnas che// chos rnams kun gyi bdag po ste// rdo rje sems dpa' gshegs su gsol// rngam pa'i zhal nas hūm̐ sgra 'brug sgrogs shing*// seng ge'i nga ros kyang ni bskyod du med// thugs rje chen po thabs kyis 'dul mdzad pa// dpal chen khro rgyal brtse phyir gshegs su gsol// snyems pa mi mnga' stobs bcur shugs ldan zhing*// ma 'dres sangs rgyas chos rnams yongs rdzogs sku// mkha' 'gro sgyu mar rol te gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ e a ral+li hriṃ hriṃ oṃ shrī badz+ra dhā pa/ puṣ+pa/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ rdo rje bdug pa mas ni mchod byas shing*// rdo rje rab tu gsang ba'i glu blangs nas// rdo rje rab tu dga' ba'i gar byas te// rnal 'byor tshogs chen dag la rol du gsol// lha mo brgyad des 'gre/ rin chen me tog ma/ pad+ma mar me ma/ las kyi dri chab ma/ sgeg phreng*/ glu/ gar ma/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam par sbyar ba 'di// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te// dam tshig gsang ba'i mchod par bzhes su gsol// oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ dgra bgegs tshogs la bstim la bsgral te/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na sarba sha trūn nā sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya ka zhes tshogs la phul bas phur pa gdab/ dgra bgegs bsgral te/ 'dre gdon che na/ dpal chen nas/ dam can la sogs pa pho nya khro bo bcu rdzogs par bskul/ de nas bdud 'dul yan chad tshogs dum bur bcad la dang po la mchod de/

sgeg po dpa' bo 'jigs su rung ba dang*// dgod dang gshe dang 'jigs par byed pa dang*// snying rje rngam dang zhi ba la sogs pa// sku yi dngos po shin tu bslab pa yi// gar byas grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa// gar gyi dbang phyug gtso bo che// zla ba la sogs snying po lnga// maṃ la sogs pa tshe 'phel dpa' bo mchog /me tog la sogs tsan+dan phreng*// bzang dgur dbul lo bzhes su gsol// ti ra ma lus rdzogs pa nye bar bsgrub pa ni// ye shes rgya mtsho thams cad dgyes shing mnan du gsol// bar pa la bshags te/ lus kyis sdig bgyis sdig pa ngan du bgyis// ngag gis tshig 'khyal smras pa ngag tu brjod// sems kyis blo nor log par bsams la sogs// 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs bgyis pa// bkra ba'i lha tshogs khyed la bzod par gsol// ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang*// de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin rnams// mi yi skyon mthong tsam na rlag par mdzad// nyams chags 'gal 'khrul mchis pa mthol zhing bshags// de nas bstabs pa bya ste/ bai ḍūr sngon po rin chen ri rab la// nyi ma stong gi 'od zer bdal ba yi// sems dpa' sngon du 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du// dpal ldan gzi brjid 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo// 'od dpung stug po sprin ltar gtibs pa yi// 'jigs byed rngam stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// za byed bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba yis// gdug pa thams cad rdo rje'i zhal du bstabs// mi bzad mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal gdangs shing*// khams gsum za bar byed pa'i rkan sgra can// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshang ba'i ming nas bton pa la bstabs/ de nas lhag ma bsdus la cho ga bya'o// bdag nyid phaṭa kyi ngang nyid du// gsal zhing blo rtog goms par bsgom// khro bo chen po tshogs pa'o// dkyil 'khor chen po zhal 'bar ba// rngam pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po dang*// bdag dang gnyis su med par bsgom// khro bo'i tshogs kyi sngags rnams dang*// gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya dang*// slas dang byi mo byi pho bran mo'i tshogs// so so'i sngags rnams rdzogs par 'don// zhal gyis rang sngags khri 'bum yang*// rnam gsum gcig tu bzlas nas kyang*// yang na bdun nam brgya rtsa brgyad// stong ngam 'bum du dbul bar bya// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

tshogs rnams 'dir 'dus shig /dur khrod brgyad kyi gnas bsrung zhing*// dam tshig rdo rje sgo 'byed ma// rdo rje srin mo 'bar ba'i tshogs// rdo rje'i khar ni spu gri'i so// rdo rje'i sgra ni cir yang sgrogs// rdo rje gzugs ni 'jigs byed ma// dam tshig ha ha'i sgra sgrogs rnams// rgyan gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la// rdo rje lcam dral bsrung ba dang*// rkyen las byung ba'i dgra bo rnams// yud tsam gyis ni med par mdzod// ces dmar gyi ar+ghas mchod do// de nas rdo rje dkyil 'khor gyi phyir byung la/ dpal gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams spyan drangs shing mchod pa bya ste/ 'jig rten las 'das pho nya mo// dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang*// yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs la// pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni// gzi ldan 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// byang chub sems kyi 'od 'phro can// dkar por 'phros pas dmar por 'khyil// dmar por 'phros pas dkar por 'khyil// phar 'khyil tshur 'khyil byin rlabs las// sprul pa'i pho nya byung ba ni// shar gyi phyogs kyi pho nya mo// gser gyi seng ge rngam khri la// mi mo seng ge'i tshul can zhon// mgo brgya ma la lag brgya ma// lag pa la la rdo rje 'chang*// lag pa la la lcags kyu 'dren// 'di 'dra gcig pur ma nges te// stong khams khyab par sprul byed ma// shar gyi phyogs nas gshegs su gsol// de yi bka' nyan pho nya ni// dung gi spyang mo mgo dgu ma// g.yu yi ral pa'i cod pan can// ral pa lcang lo re re la// pho nya lcags kyu thogs pa sprin ltar gtibs// shar lho'i mtshams nas gshegs su gsol// lho yi phyogs kyi pho nya ni// stag gi rngam khri chen mo la// mi mo stag gi tshul can zhon// mgo brgya ma la lag brgya ma// lag pa la la zhags pa thogs// lag pa la mo'i tshul can zhon// mgo brgya ma la lag brgya ma// lag pa la la lcags sgrog can// lag pa la la dbang du sdud// 'di 'dra gcig pur ma nges ste// stong khams khengs par sprul byed ma// nub kyi phyogs nas gshegs su gsol// de yi bka' sdod pho nya ni// zangs kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma// bse yi ral pa'i cod paṇa can// ral pa lcang lo re re la// pho nya lcags sgrogs thogs pa sprin ltar gtibs// nub byang mtshams nas gshegs su gsol// byang gi phyogs kyi pho nya ni// lcags kyi dril rta rkang gsum ma// mi mo lcags kyi tshul can zhon// mgo brgya ma la lag brgya ma// lag pa la la dril bu 'khrol// lag pa la /spu gri'i so la spu gri'i skra// kha brgya nas ni khus 'debs shing*// mig brgya zlog ste lta bar byed// lha srin sde brgyad phung byed cing*// 'og gi phyogs nas gshegs su gsol// steng gi phyogs kyi pho nya ni// lcags kyi spyang ki brgyad khri la// lcags kyi bya khra chen mo zhon// skya rings lus la dgu tshigs bskor// gnam phyed gos gyon nyi zla bskor// sa phyed stan 'ding klu zas gang*// mig gi nyi zla 'khyil 'dra ba// nyi zla gza' skar sku la brgyan// steng gi phyogs nas gshegs su gsol// pho nya'i tshogs chen rab 'jigs la// kun kyang ral pa 'bar ba la// lcags kyu dgra s+t+wa rab thogs shing*// stag gi mgo dang mjug ma la// he dang phaṭa kyi rngam stabs can// zhing chen yan lag 'dzin pa ste// 'jig rten khams ni kun la dbang*// bar snang khams na rgyu ba ste// g.yon pa'i lcags kyus snying nas 'dren// g.yas pa'i sta gris nges par 'joms// sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs te// mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// 'jig rten ma 'das pho nya la// gzugs ni cir yang ma nges ste// stong khams khyab pa'i lus can ma// lus gcig ma la mgo brgya ma// mgo brgya ma la spyan stong ma// zhal gcig ma la so stong ma// glog stong 'bar ba'i kha rlangs can// khrag dang thal ba'i thig les brgyan// ske rags zhing chen ba su dang*// gser gyi slog pa gos su gyon// pro dza añja rgyan du byas// gcer bu 'bar ba'i tshogs chen la// gdan mchog smug nag mer 'bar bas// 'jig rten khams kun sreg par mdzad// zhing la sdod cing 'thab tshul ston// gang la dmigs pa'i dgra bo len// khro rgyal sku yi zhal du stobs// chem chem dgongs la sa ma ya// sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la// 'dir gshegs bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pas mchod// gang la dmigs pa nor ra re// dkyil 'khor de yi phyi rim na// phra men tshogs kyis bskor ba ni// khyab byed chen mo khyung mgo ma// mtha' nas 'joms pa'i gshog rgyangs can// dgra bgegs ma lus mtha' nas btul// 'jigs byed chen mo spyang ki'i mgo
